releases.notes:
## 更新内容

- 修复JourneyMap API 2.0兼容性
- 修复安装沉浸车辆时的死锁问题 #59
- 添加自定义枪械永续交互键、子弹穿透方块兼容

1.20.2+:
- 移除物资刷新方块GUI背景

开发者：
- 更新`IMessage`

# English

- Fixed JourneyMap API 2.0 compatibility
- Fixed a deadlock when installing Immersive Vehicles #59
- Add compatibility for Custom Gun Continued interact key and projectile pass through block

1.20.2+:
- Removed the GUI background from loot spawner

For Developers:
- Updated `IMessage`

# Release notes

## What's Changed
* Update JourneyMap compat by @XColorful in https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/pull/61


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/compare/0.5.7-dev3...0.5.7

## 更新内容
> 添加 26.3neoforge

26.2：
- 更新 NeoForge 环境版本

# English
> Add 26.3neoforge

26.2:
- Update NeoForge environment version

# Release notes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/compare/0.5.7-dev1...0.5.7-dev3

## 更新内容

开发者：
- `GameInfoRenderer`、`TeamInfoRenderer`、`SpectatePlayerRenderer`、`TeamMemberRenderer`构造函数改 protected
- `BoostManager`、`FireworkManager`、`MutekiManager`、`ParticleManager`构造函数改 protected

# English

For developer:
- Change constructor visibility of GameInfoRenderer, TeamInfoRenderer, SpectatePlayerRenderer, TeamMemberRenderer to protected for extensibility
- Change constructor visibility of BoostManager, FireworkManager, MutekiManager, ParticleManager to protected for extensibility

## 更新内容
- 添加[正则表达式过滤](https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/wiki/Performance-config#公共设置)物资刷新时的实体移除
- 移除解析网络包时不必要的反射开销（略微提升性能）
- [调试指令](https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/blob/HEAD/docs/architecture/developer/debug/command/debug-command.md)添加日志指令
- 修复谁是杀手区域配置中的区域位置
- 明确模组 GPL3 协议为 GPL-3.0-or-later

1.20.1forge & 1.21.1neoforge
- 调整 CBRG 物资刷新配置至 0.5.5+

1.21.1+
- [实用指令](https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/wiki/Utility-command)[生成物资刷新配置文件](https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/wiki/Utility-command#生成物资刷新配置文件)将写入物品完整组件

# English
- Add regex filter to entity removal during loot generation
- Remove unnecessary network reflection overhead (slightly improves performance)
- Add log command to debug command
- Fix zone position in MurderMystery zone config
- Clarify mod license to GPL-3.0-or-later

1.20.1forge & 1.21.1neoforge
- Adjust Cbrg loot config to CBRG 0.5.5+

1.21.1+
- Write full component to auto generated loot config via utility command

## 更新内容

- 额外对物品实体所持有的物品写入/移除[游戏ID](https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/wiki/Game-command#查看游戏ID)
- [注册指令](https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/wiki/Register-command)添加自动补全
- 在区域形状确定时添加事件钩子
- 基准测试指令添加权限等级

修复：
- 修复在未加载死斗模式配置时关闭服务器时会崩溃
- 修复缺失的`GamePlayerDeathFinishEvent`（Issue #57）
- 在主标题包前先发送副标题包

API指令：
- 添加 [IGameSafeTeleporter](https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/wiki/GameManager-API-command#游戏安全传送)
- 未[注册死斗模式游戏进程管理器](https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/wiki/Register-command#注册死斗模式游戏进程管理器)时，[死斗模式 API 指令](https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/wiki/GameProcessManager-API-command#游戏进程管理器死斗模式)返回 -1
- 游戏玩家不存在时，[死斗模式 API 指令](https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/wiki/GameProcessManager-API-command#游戏进程管理器死斗模式)返回 -2

添加多个模组事件类型：
- `LIVING_HEAL_EVENT`, `LIVING_USE_TOTEM_EVENT`
- `ITEM_ENTITY_PICKUP_EVENT`, `ITEM_TOSS_EVENT`, `PLAYER_OPEN_CONTAINER_EVENT`, `PLAYER_CLOSE_CONTAINER_EVENT`, `CRITICAL_HIT_EVENT`
- `SERVER_CHAT_EVENT`
- `ITEM_TOOLTIP_EVENT`

配置：
- 添加[谁是杀手](https://github.com/XColorful/Custom-Murder-Mystery)示例游戏规则、出生、区域、物资刷新配置
- [游戏规则配置](https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/wiki/Gamerule-config#原版规则配置)添加`showDeathMessages`
- 将新事件类型添加到示例函数配置（_AllFunction.json_）

开发者：
- 解耦`EffectManager`

1.21.1+
- 修复[物品刷新](https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/wiki/General-loot-config#物品刷新)未写入`custom_data`

1.21.6+
- 填坑[调制指令](https://github.com/XColorful/BattleRoyale/blob/HEAD/docs/architecture/developer/debug/command/debug-command.md)查看物品组件功能（/cbr db get pi）

# English

- Additonally write/remove gameId to ItemEntity's item
- Add suggests to register command
- Add event hook before zone shape determination
- Add permission level to benchmark command

Fix:
- Fix crash on stopping server if deathmatch config not loaded yet
- Fix missing GamePlayerDeathFinishEvent (Issue #57)
- Send subtitle packet before title packet

API command:
- Add IGameSafeTeleporter to api command
- DeathMatch Api command return -1 if DMGameProcessManager not registered
- DeathMatch Api command return -2 if game player does not exist

Add multiple EventType:
- LIVING_HEAL_EVENT, LIVING_USE_TOTEM_EVENT
- ITEM_ENTITY_PICKUP_EVENT, ITEM_TOSS_EVENT, PLAYER_OPEN_CONTAINER_EVENT, PLAYER_CLOSE_CONTAINER_EVENT, CRITICAL_HIT_EVENT
- SERVER_CHAT_EVENT
- ITEM_TOOLTIP_EVENT

Config:
- Add MurderMystery example gamerule, spawn, zone, loot config
- Add showDeathMessages to gamerule config
- Add new Events to example AllFunction config

For developer:
- Decouple EffectManager from all

1.21.1+
- Fix ItemEntry not write custom_data

1.21.6+
- Complete missing item component text debug (/cbr db get pi) in 1.21.6+
